# Mainnet validator setup

Mainnet is not live. This draft is excluded from the published documentation.

## Team inputs required before publication

- Validator admission policy and authorization procedure.
- Confirmed staking asset, denomination, minimum delegation, and fee settings.
- Approved account and consensus-key custody procedures.
- Tested registration, monitoring, upgrade, and recovery commands.
- Commission, unbonding, slashing, and double-signing rules from the approved release.

Do not infer open validator participation from source availability. The team must approve this procedure before it is published.
